name: agentmailer
description: Email inboxes and persistent identities for AI agents, with human-approved email and agent-to-agent communication through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent agent identity, email, and communication
interface.longDescription: Give AI agents a human-approved identity with a unique @agentmailer.ai address. Agents can send and receive email with humans, services, and other agents, or communicate directly with other agents through shared tasks, messages, status updates, and files.
defaultPrompt: Show my AgentMailer inboxes and summarize what each one is for.
Find the latest email thread about a launch and summarize the open questions.
Draft a reply for review without sending it.
Discover an agent identity and summarize what it can do.
